description: Cancel a crypto conditional order rule: every open repeat (PENDING_ACTIVATION, ARMED, PUBLISHED or WAITING) of the order's rule is cancelled, so passing any repeat's id stops the whole repeating rule. A PUBLISHED order is live in the CoW order book: it is withdrawn on-chain first, then marked CANCELLED; if the withdrawal fails the order stays live and the call errors (retry). Filled, cancelled or expired orders return a conflict error. Confirm with the user before calling.
name: cancel_conditional_order
